title: saudi_air_defense_short
hook: Saudi Arabia is running out of missiles?!
question: Should the U.S. join the fight? Comment below!

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: A Houthi missile just hit *Riyadh's main airport*. Thirteen dead, around three hundred wounded.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: The next day, the airport was hit *again*. It's the deadliest attack on a Gulf state since the Iran war began.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: And Saudi officials say the kingdom is *running low* on interceptor missiles.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Each attack burns through expensive Patriot missiles, and they can't be made *overnight*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Officials say batteries are being moved to protect *palaces and oil sites*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: So Riyadh asked allies for help, including *Pakistan*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: France, Britain and Egypt were asked too.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Pakistan's military says its forces *are already there*, under a new mutual defense pact.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: But Pakistan says its troops *won't cross the border* to attack the Houthis.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Now President Trump says he is weighing *joining the fight* against the Houthis.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Should America get involved? *Tell us in the comments*.
